zh-CN.importHint: 选择审核过的离线运行包，检查内容后确认导入。
zh-CN.uploading: 正在上传并检查运行包…
zh-CN.sent: 操作已提交，正在核实结果
zh-CN.noEnvironment: 请先导入完整的文档运行环境
zh-CN.defaultInstruction: 将报价 PDF 整理为 Markdown 和 Excel，保留所有原始数据。
zh-CN.scopeNotice: 仅使用所选 PDF、获准的领域知识和运行环境，交付 Markdown 与 Excel。
zh-CN.capacityNotice: 将空闲服务的容量从 1 调整为 2，让主会话与原生验收各保留一个执行槽。
zh-CN.imageNotice: 环境镜像仅来自审核过的离线包。项目镜像包含本机私有状态；从镜像新建任务会创建独立工作副本，并重新授权。
zh-CN.rollbackImage: 将所选副本回滚到镜像
zh-CN.imageReview: 确认所列镜像、摘要和来源后执行；仅保存磁盘，内存恢复尚未验收。
zh-CN.newProject: 新任务；不读取历史产物
zh-CN.maintenanceUnsupported: 此运行包不支持手动资源清理。
zh-CN.storageNotice: 仅手动确认清理。实际占用包含共享块估算，不等于保证释放量；已验收产物单独保留。
zh-CN.resourceBlocked: 需要核实原状态后才能清理
zh-CN.resource_unresolved_operations: 存在未决操作；先核对原回执
zh-CN.resource_registered_vm_reference: 仍有工作副本引用此镜像
zh-CN.resource_termination_or_custody_unconfir: 终止或产物保管未确认
zh-CN.resource_unverifiable_storage: 存储内容无法核实，保留原数据
zh-CN.resource_unsafe_or_missing_directory: 目录无法核实，保留原数据
zh-CN.resource_unexpected_or_shared_files: 存在未识别或共享文件
zh-CN.resource_unsafe_or_missing_file: 文件无法核实，保留原数据
zh-CN.resource_unregistered_resources: 存在未注册资源，保留原数据并先核实

en.importHint: Select a reviewed offline runtime bundle, inspect its contents, then confirm import.
en.noEnvironment: Import a complete document environment first
en.defaultInstruction: Convert the quote PDF into Markdown and Excel, preserving all source facts.
en.scopeNotice: Use only the selected PDF, approved domain knowledge and runtime to deliver Markdown and Excel.
en.capacityNotice: Change idle service capacity from 1 to 2 for the primary session and native validator.
en.imageNotice: Environment images come only from reviewed offline bundles. Project images contain private local state. Each new task receives an independent copy and new authorization.
en.rollbackImage: Roll back selected copy to image
en.imageReview: Confirm the listed image, digest and source. Disk only; memory restoration remains unqualified.
en.maintenanceUnsupported: This runtime does not support manual resource cleanup.
en.storageNotice: Cleanup requires confirmation. Allocated bytes include shared-block estimates, not guaranteed free space. Accepted products are retained separately.
en.resourceBlocked: Original state must be verified before cleanup
en.resource_registered_vm_reference: Still referenced by a working copy
